summary: Source Workbench ordinary project/model/version writes require matching usable record receipts before local effects or follow-up reads. Confirmed deletion removes only matching local records before refresh, fences older catalog and affected version reads, preserves the live model and unrelated selection, and guards newer feedback. Deferred model/version rows are filtered against current identities so blocked catalog reads cannot retain removed rows; version/catalog refresh start independently. Thirty-two new isolated mocked-service Chromium controls, 89 added frontend controls and ten new real JSON/SQLite API controls verify scoped boundaries. Existing idempotent checkpoint saves remain unchanged. This is not installed, remote, authenticated provenance, ambiguous-write, power-loss, exactly-once or whole-desktop qualification. No persistent archive or production Node dependency is added.

required_text: read recovery must not replay an unconfirmed library write
version deletion recovers history independently of a blocked catalog read
membership filtering is linear, not a nested scan
Library DELETE returns the removed record, not a separate boolean deletion flag.
cannot be repeated or recreated by editing
is separate from a subsequent unavailable catalog read
backend tests, not backend production behavior
